s: Din harauy lered lipne hatteba ubo l"v seipim: ad "yishtabbach" en tzarik lishliach tzibbur sheyyered lipne hatteba kelal, abal keshemmaggiim le"yishtabbach" yesh lo lehashsheliach tzibbur laamod lipne hatteba velomar "yishtabbach", velo yamtin millered lipne hatteba ad haqqaddish shelleachar "yishtabbach", lepi sheyyesh lehasmik haqqaddish le"yishtabbach" bekol mah sheepshar veasur lehapsiq benehem kelal. Velaken nahagu shehashsheliach tzibbur omed gam ken kesheomer "yishtabbach", shello lehapsiq mishiba laamida ben "yishtabbach" laqqaddish shelleacharayv, shehu tzarik lomar oto baamida min haddin, mippene shehu dabar shebbiqdusha, vehu haddin le"bareku". Bammeh debarim amurim? Bishliach tzibbur sheomer gup haqqaddish u"bareku", abal hatztzibbur sheonin acharayv yesh omerim sheenam tzerikim laamod kemo sheyyitbaer besiman (n"h) [n"v]. Veap al pi ken nohagin laamod bishat amirat "yishtabbach", apillu kesheomer oto beyachid:

Ap al pi sheen tzarik hashsheliach tzibbur lomar lipne hatteba ella mi"yishtabbach" veelak, mikkol maqom tzarik sheyyiqra leatzmo techilla qetzat pesuqe dezimra u"baruk sheamar" lipnehem, veim lav eno yakol lomar "yishtabbach" shehare hi beraka acharona lipsuqe dezimra kemo shennitbaer besiman n"a. Velaken tzarik limchot barabbim shettoim keshehem badderek veen et lehaarik shemmatchilin mi"yishtabbach" umebarekin beraka lebattala, ella yomru "baruk sheamar" uqetzat pesuqe dezimra al derek shennitbaer besiman n"b, o yatchilu mi"yotzer or":

Mi shello haya lo tallit ad shehiggia le"yishtabbach" — lo yebarek al atipat tzitzit ben pesuqe dezimra le"yishtabbach", veen tzarik lomar beemtza pesuqe dezimra, mippene sheasur lehapsiq mi"baruk sheamar" ad sop "yishtabbach" apillu letzorek mitzva kemo shennitbaer besiman n"a, ella yebarek ben "yishtabbach" le"yotzer", sheaz muttar lehapsiq letzorek mitzva kemo sheyyitbaer besiman n"d. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyachid, abal sheliach tzibbur shello hebiu lo tallit ad "yishtabbach" — yitattep vibarek qodem sheyyatchil "yishtabbach", kede sheyyomar haqqaddish miyyad achar "yishtabbach" velo yapsiq, ella im ken hebiu lo achar "yishtabbach" kemo sheyyitbaer besiman n"d. Veken im en minyan bebet hakkeneset — yamtin hashsheliach tzibbur im "yishtabbach" veyishtoq velo yedabber kelum ad sheyyabo minyan, veyomar "yishtabbach" veqaddish, veyakol lehamtin velishhot apillu chatzi shaa shezzehu shiur kede ligmor et kol pesuqe dezimra mi"baruk sheamar" ad sop "yishtabbach", veap al pi ken en tzarik lachazor larosh hoil veshaha birtzono shello mechamat ones kemo sheyyitbaer besiman s"h. Ubediabad apillu shaha mechamat ones, kegon shello haya hammaqom naqi vekayyotze bazeh, beinyan shebbiqriat shema kayyotze bazeh yesh shemmatzrikim lachazor larosh kemo sheyyitbaer sham, mikkol maqom bipsuqe dezimra shehem middibre soperim — yesh lismok al dibre hammeqillin sham:

Sheliach tzibbur tzarik sheyyihyeh hagun, shenneemar: "notna alay beqolah al ken senetiha", veameru chakamim: zeh sheliach tzibbur sheeno hagun veyored lipne hatteba. Veezehu hagun? Sheyyihyeh reqan meaberot, vesheyyihyeh pirqo naeh, dehaynu shello yatza alayv shem ra apillu beyalduto, vesheyyihyeh anav umerutztzeh laam kede sheyyaskimu litpillato, veyesh lo neima veqol areb shemmoshek halleb, veragil liqrot battora nebiim uketubim, kede sheyyihyu happesuqim shel tepilla sedurim bepiv:

Im en motzein mi sheyyihyu bo kol hammiddot hallalu — yibcharu hattob shebbatztzibbur bechokma umaasim tobim. Veim haya kan am haaretz zaqen veqolo naim vehaam chapetzim bo uben y"g shana hammebin mah shehu omer veen qolo naim — hu qodem leam haaretz hazzaqen, ki yodea mah mitpallel:

Mi sheabar abera beshogeg, apillu harag nepesh bishgaga vechazar bitshuba — muttar lihyot sheliach tzibbur, mippene shello niqra "en pirqo naeh" ella mi shemmuad laasot debarim sheenam mehugganim, abal mi shebbaa leyado shigegat maaseh umitcharet — hare zeh tzaddiq gamur lekol hattora kullah. Abal im asa bemezid (peamim rabbot), ap al pi sheachar kak asa teshuba gemura — en memannin oto sheliach tzibbur, shehare mikkol maqom yatza alayv shem ra qodem hatteshuba velo haya pirqo naeh. Umikkol maqom, im abar abera beones apillu hemir beones veshab — yakol lihyot sheliach tzibbur qabua. Vekol zeh lemannoto sheliach tzibbur lekattechilla, abal en maabirin oto mippene shem ra sheyyatza alayv beyalduto, o apillu yatza alayv miqqarob veyadua. Veim yotze alayv shem ra atta, vehu qol sheeno poseq (veen lo oyebim hammotziim qol) — apillu yachid yakol limchot lehaabiro. Usheliach tzibbur sheyyatza peamim rabbot terepa mittachat yado — mesalleqin oto mishsheliach tzibbur, veen machazirin oto apillu achar sheyyaaseh teshuba hammaksharto lihyot shochet ubodeq kebattechilla, kevan shekkebar yatza alayv shem ra paam achat vesillequhu — shub en memannin oto lekattechilla:

Rauy lishliach tzibbur sheyyikkanes lebet hakkeneset rishon veyetze acharon. Vetob lachazor achar sheliach tzibbur ben tzaddiq, ki eno domeh tepillat tzaddiq ben tzaddiq ku'. Veyesh omerim shetztzaddiq ben rasha tepillato al hatztzibbur yoter nishmaat mittepillat ben tzaddiq, lepi shemmittok sheen lo zekut abot hu shepal ruach bitpillato, sheen boteach bitpillato al maaseh abotayv kemo ben tzaddiq ki im al chasdo shel haqqadosh baruk hu (uleinyan maaseh hakkol lepi inyan shiplut ruach shel zeh vetzidqat abotayv shel zeh):
En mumin poselin ella bekohanim abal lo bishliach tzibbur. Veap al pi ken yesh lizzaher bemumin haggeluyim, mishshum "haqribehu na lepechateka hayirtzeka vego'":

En memannin ella mi shennitmalle zeqano, mippene kebod hatztzibbur. Vaapillu hatztzibbur mochalin al kebodam — asur. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bishliach tzibbur qabua, abal beaqray yakol lered lipne hatteba mishshehebi b' searot, ubilbad shello yitmanneh mippi hatztzibbur o mippi sheliach tzibbur hamemanneh oto lehaqel mealayv lehitpallel baado leittim, shezzehu gam ken qebiut leotam haittim. Abal im minnuhu hatztzibbur o hashsheliach tzibbur sheyyihyeh hu mukan lehitpallel lipamim keshello yihyeh sheliach tzibbur bebet hakkeneset — en zeh niqra qebiut, kevan sheepshar shello yabo lide kak. Velo aseru ella leittim yeduim, shelleoto et hu qabua bevadday. Vekol zeh bekol hashshana, abal betaanit — tzarik lihyot zaqen mammash sheliach tzibbur lekattechilla kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tqa"t, o hammuplag shebbatztzibbur. Vehu haddin berosh hashshana veyom kippur — tob sheyyihyeh adam muplag sheliach tzibbur im epshar:
Im en sham mi sheyyodea lihyot sheliach tzibbur ki im ben y"g shana veyom echad — mutab sheyyihyeh hu sheliach tzibbur ap al pi sheen lo zaqan mishsheyyitbattelu millishmoa qedushsha veqaddish:

Mi sheeno baal zaqan, kol shennikkar bo shehiggia liklal shanim sherauy lehitmalleot zeqano — hare zeh keillu nitmalle zeqano. Lepikak ben k' shana ap al pi sheen lo zaqan — memannin oto. Veken im haya lo zaqan apillu meat — hare zeh kenitmalle zeqano im hu mibben y"ch shana vamala:

Saris, yesh omerim shemmuttar lemannoto im hu ben esrim, sheaz naasa gadol. Vehu shenniru bo simane saris, veim lo nira bo — eno niqra gadol ad sheyyaabru rob shenotayv, kemo sheyyitbaer beh"a siman qa"b. Veyesh mi sheomer sheap al pi ken en zeh kebod hatztzibbur lemannot saris:

Yesh lelammed zekut al meqomot shennohagin shehaqqetannim yoredim lipne hatteba lehitpallel arbit bemotzae shabbatot, lepi sheen motziin et harabbim yede chobatan, shehare enan machazirin et hattepilla raq sheomerim "bareku" veqaddish. Ubimqomot shello nahagu ken — en laqqatan laabor lipne hatteba apillu bitpillat arbit (mishshum "bareku" shebbah. Vehu haddin shello yipros al shema lemi shello shama "bareku" beshacharit. Veen "bareku" shel tepillat shacharit vearbit domeh le"bareku" shel qeriat hattora sheqqatan yakol leomrah, lepi sheenah choba kol kak ella al haoleh liqrot battora, abal ellu hen choba al kol tzibbur leshoman shacharit vearbit), veqatan sheeno chayyab — eno motziam yede chobatan. Vaapillu mi shemmaggia liklal y"g shana beyom hashshabbat — en lo lehitpallel arbit shel shabbat bimqomot shennohagin lehitpallel shel shabbat beereb shabbat mibbeod yom mishshum tosepet shabbat, shehare adayin lo nishlemu lo y"g shana ad lel shabbat, shettosepet shabbat enah moil leinyan shenot yeme hannaar. Abal im mitpallel ballayla arbit — muttar lered lipne hatteba. Umah sheameru: y"g shana veyom echad, lo shetztzarik yom echad yoter al y"g shana, ella lomar shetztzarik y"g shana shelemot miyyom el yom velo sheyyom echad bishnat y"g nechshab shana. Abal miyyad shehiggia techillat kenisat hayyom shennolad bo vekalu bo y"g shana shelemot — hare miqtzat kenisat hayyom zeh nechshab keyom shalem vahare hu ben y"g veyom echad, veen tzarik y"g shana meet leet. Veim tzarik libdoq im hebi b' searot — yitbaer besiman n"h:

Sheliach tzibbur shemmaarik bitpillato kede sheyyishmeu qolo heareb, im hu mechamat shessameach belibbo al shennoten hodaa lehaqqadosh baruk hu binima — tabo alayv beraka. Vehu sheyyitpallel bekobed rosh veomed beema veyira, abal im mekavven lehashmia qolo vesameach beqolo — hare zeh megunneh, vealayv neemar "notna alay beqolah al ken senetiha". Umikkol maqom, kol shemmaarik bitpillato — lo tob hu oseh, mippene torach hatztzibbur:
Mi sheyyesh lo qol naim — yerannen lehaqqadosh baruk hu, velo shear renanot. Veim raq — yeqanneach veachar kak yitpallel:

En memannin laage sapa sheenan yodein lechattek haotiyyot, kegon ellu sheqqorin lealpi"n ayni"n uleayni"n alpi"n. Vehu haddin lemi sheqqore lecheti"n hehi"n. Veim kullam medabberim kak — muttar lihyot sham sheliach tzibbur, veen tzarik lehabi lahem sheliach tzibbur mimmaqom acher:

Pocheach vehu mi shebbigdo qarua uzerootayv megullim — lo yered lipne hatteba mippene kebod hatztzibbur. Verauy lishliach tzibbur sheyyihyeh lo begadim arukkim, shello yerau raglayv (im holek belo anpilaot):
Suma yored lipne hatteba, mippene shechayyab bekol hammitzvot veyakol lehotzi et harabbim yede chobatan. Veim yakol laalot veliqrot battora — yitbaer besiman qm"a:

Sheliach tzibbur qabua yored lipne hatteba meatzmo velo yamtin ad sheyyomru lo, lepi shennireh sheeno somek al dibbur hatztzibbur shemminnuhu lekak. Abal mi sheeno sheliach tzibbur qabua — tzarik lesareb meat qodem sheyyored lipne hatteba. Velo yesareb yoter midday, ella paam rishona mesareb umemaen legamre, kelomar eni keday lekak, ukesheyyomru lo paam shenit — mekin atzmo kemo sherotzeh laamod, ubepaam shelishi yaamod. Veim haomer lo sheyyered hu adam gadol — eno mesareb lo kelal, sheen mesorbin legadol ella bedabar sheyyesh bo gassut userara kemo sheyyitbaer besiman q"a:
Im taa hashsheliach tzibbur utzerikin lehaamid acher tachtayv — oto shemmaamidin tachtayv lo yesareb kelal, mippene sheggenay hu shettehe hattepilla mupseqet kol kak:

Haomer eni ober lipne hatteba mippene shebbegaday tzebuim o mippene hassandal shebberaglay — lo yered beoto hattepilla kelal, lo bitzbuim velo bilbanim, velo besandal velo yachep, mippene shedderek haeppiqoresin lehaqpid bekak vechosheshin shemma eppiqoresut nizreqa bo. Veap al pi shennoten taam lidbarayv umareh panim shellikbod hammaqom oseh ken vederek anava hu ochez lilbosh lebanim, mikkol maqom kevan shehatztzibbur mebaqshim mimmennu lehitpallel lahem kak — en rauy lo lihyot sorban mippene debarim ellu, im lo sheeppiqoresut nizreqa bo:

Yesh moneim ger millihyot sheliach tzibbur, mippene sheeno yakol lomar "elohe abotenu". Venidchu dibrehem sheap haggerim yekolim lomar "elohe abotenu", shenneemar: "ki ab hamon goyim netattika", kelomar mikkan veelak atta ab lekol haggoyim sheyyitgayyeru:

Apillu yachid yakol leakkeb velomar eni rotzeh sheppeloni yihyeh sheliach tzibbur, im lo shehiskim alayv mittechilla. Verabbim yekolim lachazor bahem apillu achar shehiskimu. Vegam bekol hamminnuyim yakol yachid leakkeb, vaapillu bemarbitz tora, vehu sherotzeh leqabbel sheliach tzibbur o rab acher veyesh acher liskor bedamayv shel zeh sherob hatztzibbur chapetzim bo. Vekol mi sheheebiruhu veamad kak yamim behaskamat haqqahal veachar kak rotzim lachazor ulemannoto — hare zo kitchillat qabbala, vaapillu yachid yakol leakkeb. Vehu haddin im minnuhu techilla lizman veachar kak nishlam hazzeman. Veen hayyachid yakol leakkeb bekol maqom, ella kesheyyesh lo taam hagun veyatztzia tamo lipne tobe hair, veim yiru sheddebarayv nekonim sherauy lo leakkeb mittaam zeh — yachoshu lidbarayv velo yemannuhu. Veim hu sone lehashsheliach tzibbur — yakol limchot shello yemannuhu lishliach tzibbur. Abal im kebar hiskimu alayv veachar kak naasa soneo — eno yakol limchot, ella hashsheliach tzibbur mechuyyab lomar bepiv sheyyasir haqqina millibbo veyotziennu bitpillato. Vekol zeh bayyamim harishonim shehayu hakkol mitkavvenim leshem shamayim, abal akshav im hayu chosheshin ledibre yachid — leolam lo hayu yekolin lehashvot lemannot shum minnuy, ki kol echad haya metil mum baqqodashim vezeh mocheh beshel zeh vezeh mocheh beshel zeh, lepikak nohagin lelek achar rob deot shel poree sekar hashsheliach tzibbur apillu yesh pesule qurba benehem. Veyesh meqomot memannin y"a o y"g anashim al zeh, vehakkol shello yarbu machaloqet, veen mashgichin al hammiutim:
Sheliach tzibbur tzarik lihyot ahub laqqahal, sheim lo ken kesheqqore hattokecha — sakkana hi lemi sheeno ohabo. Veim hu soneo — lo yaaleh:
Yiru shello yihyeh sheliach tzibbur tippesh, sheyyukal lehitasseq betzorke tzibbur karauy. Veen hashsheliach tzibbur tzarik lehachanip latztzibbur bemille dishmayya, vetzarik lehokichan:

Im echad abel al abiv verotzeh lehitpallel kederek haabelim veechad rotzeh lehitpallel bishbil acher — mi sheyyirtzeh haqqahal sheyyitpallel hu yitpallel, sheqqaddish bilbad hu yakol lomar bishbil abiv shello middaat haqqahal, abal lo yukal lihyot sheliach haqqahal lehitpallel al korcham. Velaken, ap al pi shennohagin shehammohel docheh haabel millehitpallel, mikkol maqom im haqqahal rotzim sheyyitpallel haabel — zaka haabel. Veyom shemmet bo abiv veimmo sheqqorin yartzayy"t qodem lammohel, im en haqqahal maqpidim bekak:
En lemannot sheliach tzibbur al pi hassar, ap al pi sherob hatztzibbur chapetzim bo, ki chalila leqabbel abodat boreenu al yede hannokrim, "ki lo ketzurenu vego'":

Sheliach tzibbur yoter rauy lihyot besakar mibbindaba, lepi shebbemaqom shehu loqeach sakar barur min haqqahal — en peretz veen tzevacha, sheen acher sheeno hagun rashshay lipshot raglo lehitpallel, veim haya bindaba hareshut netuna lakkol ubiprotz haddabar yaaleh mi sheeno hagun, vegam hashsheliach tzibbur nizhar bitpillato vetiqqunayv keshehu sakir:

En leadam lehitpallel belo retzon haqqahal. Vekol mi shemmitpallel shello birshut mechamat allamut vegeut — en onin amen achar birkotayv, shenneemar: "ubotzea berek nietz Hashem". Veen lehitqotet baabur shum mitzva, kegon gelilat seper tora vekayyotze bo, shehare hatztzenuin moshekin yedehem millechem happanim vehaggargera[ni]yam chotepin vaakilat lechem happanim hu mitzvat aseh shel tora:

Sekar sheliach tzibbur, yesh omerim shepporeim miqquppat haqqahal sheggobin lepi mamon kol ish keerko. Veap al pi shehashsheliach tzibbur motzi et haddal keashir, mikkol maqom en yad heani masseget keashir. Veken kol mah shehi taqqanat hatztzibbur venaasa al yede mamon — notenim lepi mamon. Veyesh omerim sheggobin chatzi lepi mamon vachatzi lepi nepashot, ki yesh sebara lomar sheheani tzarik lehashsheliach tzibbur kemo heashir, veyesh lipamim shehaashirim mosipim besakar lehashsheliach tzibbur sheqqolo areb yoter veen haaniyyim chapetzim bekak, al ken asu peshara zot. Veken hu minhag qehillot bimdinot harbeh. Ubiqtzat meqomot dal veashir notenim beshaveh, ak yesh lo qitzba mikkol nissuin vezeh lepi mamon. Ubemaqom sheen minhag — yesh ligbot lepi mamon, shebberob happeamim haashirim mosipim besakar lepi neimat haqqol veen yad haaniyyim masseget latet immahem:

Tzibbur shetztzerikim liskor rab usheliach tzibbur veen beyadam kede sippuq shenehem, im hu rab mubhaq ubaqi behoraa — hu qodem lishliach tzibbur, shettalmud tora qodem lakkol. Veim lav — sheliach tzibbur qodem, kede lehotzi harabbim yede chobatan. Veen mesalleqin sheliach tzibbur meumanuto ella im ken nimtza bo pesul beedim, abal lo mishshum rinnun beolma kegon sheyyatza alayv shem shennitpas im hannokrit, o shemmasar mamon yisrael beyad nokri. Umikkol maqom yesh lehoshib bet din al kaka, veim yabou alayv edim bazeh vekayyotze bazeh — maabirin oto veen chozerin umeqabbelin oto ad sheyyashub bitshuba shelema beli orma. Vaapillu nishba shello yelek od bidrakim ellu — en zeh kelum shehare kebar mushba veomed hu mehar sinay:

Sheliach tzibbur shehu shochet ubodeq — lo yitpallel bibgadim hatztzoin umasrichin. Vetob sheyyachalop begadayv kol hayyom keshemmehallek ben habberiyyot, shello yihyeh biklal mesanay ahabu mavet. Veim eno rotzeh lehachalip begadayv bishat hattepilla ulehitpallel — maabirin oto. Usheliach tzibbur hamnabbel piv, o shemmerannen battepilla beshire hannokrim shemmenaggenim bahem laabodat elilim — mochin beyado shello laasot ken. Veim eno shomea — maabirim oto:

Sheliach tzibbur shehizqin verotzeh lemannot beno lesayyeo lipraqim, ap al pi sheen qol beno areb keqolo, im memalle meqomo bishar debarim veen qolo meshunneh — en hatztzibbur yekolim limchot beyado, lepi shekkol hammitmanneh lishliach tzibbur min hassetam al daat ken nitmanna sheim lipamim lo yukal lehitpallel sheyyemanneh acher lesayyeo, veim ken beno qodem besiyyua lekol adam. Vaapillu achar moto beno qodem lekol adam, ki ken hu bekol hamminnuyim shehabben sherauy lekak qodem apillu laacherim sheggedolim mimmennu, chutz mimminnuyim shel keter tora, kegon chakam hamemunneh leharbitz tora o laddin, shehattora enah yerushsha:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bemaqom sheen sham minhag, abal im hamminhag hu sheen beno qodem leacher — yaasu keminhagam. Vaapillu im nahagu lemannot hashsheliach tzibbur atzmo al zeman yadua ubiklot hazzeman maabirin oto umemannin acher tachtayv — yaasu keminhagam, veen bazeh mishshum bizzayon lo kevan shennahagu kak. Vehu haddin lishar minnuyim hatztzerikim latztzibbur, kegon quppa shel tzedaqa vekayyotze bah mishshear tzorke tzibbur, ben shennotelin alehem sakar ben sheen notelin, im nahagu lemannot anashim lizman ubehaggia hazzeman yatzeu ellu veniknesu acherim tachtehem, apillu lo qabeu lahem zeman beperush keshemminnu otam — setaman keperushan, meachar shennahagu kak:
En nakon lehaabir sheliach tzibbur (tok zemanno) bishbil acher sheqqolo areb yoter. Veim harob chapetzim baacher — yeshammeshu shenehem keechad:

Yesh mi sheomer sherauy lishliach tzibbur sheyyitpallel mittok hassiddur hamyuchad latztzibbur, shebbevadday niktab leshem shamayim velo leshem hitpaarut. Abal behannidpasin en chilluq ben shel tzibbur leacher:
